content:
I have built an index that runs from published mathematics to Lean: the entry point is a paper, not a repository.

It covers roughly 5M records, with formalization artifacts attached to the papers they formalize (Palomar entries, arXiv formalization papers). Each link is verified individually against the authors of the source paper. Every record carries a permanent code, such as MiNDS3MDGRHZCD5.

https://mathinsid.org

It is still early. Such an index should become more useful as the formalized corpus grows in size and level.

Corrections and suggestions are very welcome.

Method: arXiv:2606.11430
